headline: Solar Storm Forecast to Hit Earth, Threatening Satellites and Radios
summary: A solar storm forecast to impact Earth between November 6 and 7 brings possible interferences to satellite communications and radio frequencies, without generalized blackouts.
why: Geomagnetic disturbances and solar storms pose operational risks to satellite constellations, telecommunications networks, and power grid stability.

impacts.name: Telecommunications
impacts.why: Solar disturbances can cause temporary signal interference in satellites and radio.
